entry.confirm_signal: Short tone sequence at power-up, a double tone sequence after about 10 s, a triple tone sequence about 3 s later.
steps: Receiver connected, transmitter on, throttle stick forward.
Connect battery power: short tone sequence.
After about 10 s: double tone sequence.
After about 3 s more: triple tone sequence.
Programming mode: parameter 1 shown as one beep and one LED flash, repeating.

announce.description: Parameter N is announced as N beeps with N LED flashes, repeating. Inside a parameter the stored value shows as the beep rate: beep every 2 s with the LED on, or beep every 0.5 s with the LED flashing.

select.description: To change the value, move the stick from forward to stop and hold it at least 3 s, then move quickly stop, forward, stop.

skip.description: Parameter select: a short move from forward to stop and back to forward steps to the next parameter.

scheme.confirm_signal: Not described beyond the changed LED and beep pattern. The change is stored by a stop-to-forward move.
scheme.description: Forward stick at power-up enters a three-stage tone sequence after about 13 s. A short forward-stop-forward move steps through parameters 1 to 5. In a parameter, holding stop for 3 s and then moving quickly stop, forward, stop toggles the value, which the ESC shows as the beep rate. Power loss stores the settings.

unknowns: Defaults of all parameters: not stated.
Beep duration and the 'quick' stop-forward-stop move time: not stated.
Which of the two table columns is value 1 and which is value 2: the manual gives only the column order (LED on / beep every 2 s first, LED flashing / beep every 0.5 s second).
The manual's table for 'Bremse (AIR)' and 'Governor (HELI)' lists AUS then EIN; the row for 'Rückwärts' also AUS then EIN.
Which model type (AIR, HELI, BOAT, CAR) a model has at delivery: not stated.
Programming the stick positions forward, stop and reverse (sec. 3.1) needs a 10 s wait, a double tone and a triple tone; durations not stated.
Parameter 3 meaning depends on the model type set by parameters 4 and 5; the manual says set those first.
notes: The stick positions forward, stop and reverse are taught first (section 3.1): forward at power-up, a double tone after about 10 s confirms forward, stop gives a short tone, reverse gives a triple tone. Forward-only controllers learn forward and stop only (section 3.2).
The 900 series table also lists safety features only (SPS, PCO, POR, hec); no further stick items exist.
announce.repeat 0 means the sequence repeats until a choice is made (manual: "continuous").
